responsibility: This implementation module provides the actual low-level heap allocator used by GNU Modula-2 runtime components by wrapping libc malloc, realloc, free, and memset. It halts through Debug on allocation failure, optionally zeroes freed memory, can emit trace records controlled by environment variables, and exposes availability probing and a no-op heap Init entry point. It is the storage backend beneath the public Storage module and utility modules such as DynamicStrings and Indexing.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation half of the SysStorage pair: it performs allocation through malloc/realloc/free, optional memset-on-free, tracing via environment-controlled debug output, and failure halts, whereas SysStorage.def only publishes the allocator interface.
